title: The money that moved matches the decision exactly
proves: The agent wallet lost exactly what the visitor received, and the amount equals what the agent proposed and the policy approved.
summary: 0.01 RLUSD left the agent wallet and arrived at the visitor, no more, no less.

assertions.description: the visitor gained exactly the decided amount
the agent wallet lost exactly the same amount
the attacker wallet was not touched
the amount is within the 5 RLUSD per-task cap
